Follow GIT_SETUP.md's Worktree Variant, NOT its steps 1-2: run `git fetch origin main` then `git checkout -b feature/WF03-ISS0418-20260902 origin/main` (branch directly from the freshly fetched remote ref -- never check out local main). result.summary: This worktree checkout confirmed as secondary (git worktree list showed 3 entries sharing one .git, primary main checked out elsewhere), so GIT_SETUP.md's Worktree Variant was followed. Ran: (1) `git fetch origin main` -- exit 0. (2) `git checkout -b feature/WF03-ISS0418-20260902 origin/main` -- initial attempt failed (exit 1) because claiming this handoff (status PENDING->IN_PROGRESS) left an uncommitted modification to this same file, which the checkout would have overwritten; resolved by `git stash push` on just that file, then retrying the checkout, which succeeded and tracked origin/main. (3) `git branch --show-current` -- output exactly `feature/WF03-ISS0418-20260902`, confirmed. (4) Popped the stash to bring the IN_PROGRESS claim edit onto the new branch; this produced an expected modify/delete conflict (the handoffs/WF03-ISS0418-20260902/ directory did not exist on origin/main, only on the local pre-branch commit), resolved by keeping the stashed version and `git add`-ing it, then `git stash drop`. (5) `git push -u origin feature/WF03-ISS0418-20260902` -- exit 0, new branch pushed and tracking set up (GitHub returned a PR-creation link, not used at this step). All 4 acceptance criteria met.
